verdicts.title: Zheghalkin-Boolean Calculus
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Boolean calculus has been studied extensively in the past in the context of switching circuits, error-correcting codes etc. This work generalizes several approaches to defining a differential calculus for Boolean functions. A unified theory of Boolean calculus, complete with k-forms and integration, is presented through the use of Zhegalkin algebras (i.e., algebraic normal forms), culminating in a Stokes-like theorem for Boolean functions.

verdicts.title: A refinement of Stone duality to skew Boolean algebras
